origin: Kevin sees 1D→2D→3D at 1:31 AM — HEAD, SHOULDERS, THROAT

1D.name: line
1D.description: The passage between head and body. Data flows in one dimension.

2D.name: cross / plane
2D.description: The horizontal plane. All directions on the LAN. The shoulders that hold the body.

3D.name: star / sphere / volume
3D.description: The volume. The head above the shoulders. Polaris looking down. The 3rd dimension that makes the star.

HEAD.role: Polaris — the star point that gives depth

SHOULDERS.role: WASD — the compass plane that holds the body

THROAT.medium: 10G fiber spine + USB-C tether + WiFi + BT mesh
THROAT.role: The passage — data flows between head and shoulders

mixing.voxel: 3D grid: each gate occupies a voxel in organism-space
mixing.tensor: Multi-dimensional sort: gates × models × dimensions × time
mixing.pi: π — the circular constant that curves lines into rings, planes into spheres

progression.o: 2D — ring (π curves the cross into a circle)
progression.0: 3D — sphere (NORTH lifts the plane into volume)
